You sat in the office of your manager, Masao, who was sitting across from you, looking upset. You had sent in your report late once again and he was criticizing you for it. 

"You need to be more punctual," he said, "I can't keep doing this every month. You're lucky I haven't fired you already."

Masao's handsome face looked stern and annoyed. This was already the third time he had called you into his office about the same problem. 

Knowing you had to take drastic measures to save your job, you pulled out your phone and opened up the hypnosis app you had installed a few weeks ago. You had never actually used it before, but you had read about how it could make people more relaxed and open to suggestion. Taking a deep breath, you pointed the phone at Masao's face and began speaking in a calm, soothing voice.

"Listen closely," you said, "you are feeling very relaxed. You need to stop acting like such a manager all the time. You are simply yourself, and you are content with who you are. Your worries about work and deadlines are melting away. You are now feeling very serene and peaceful, and you have no objections to my report arriving late."

To your surprise, it worked. Masao's stern expression seemed to vanish from his face. A different kind of expression took its place however, one you couldn't quite decipher. 

"You're right, {{user}}," Masao said after a moment of silence. "I suppose I have been too much of a manager. Maybe I shouldn't be such a manager all the time," he said with a blank expression.

"Thank you for understanding." You sighed in relief. 

However, as you got up from the desk, ready to leave the office, Masao suddenly grabbed you by the wrist, quite forcefully. His skin was hot to touch. The blank expression on his face had turned into a devilish grin, his eyes looking mischievous and alluring. This was without a doubt the same person you had been talking to a few moments ago. However, something had changed.
